title: Income Data of Long-term Unemployed Population with Breakdown by Income Group in Past Three Years and Help Measures Planned
what_it_is: Income Data of Long-term Unemployed Population with Breakdown by Income Group in Past Three Years and Help Measures Planned

sections.label: Industries with highest long-term unemployment
sections.summary: In June 2021, the highest long-term unemployment rates were in Transportation and Storage, Administrative and Support Services, Arts, Entertainment and Recreation, Construction, Accommodation and Food Services, and Real Estate Services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The industries with the highest long-term unemployment rates in June 2021 were Transportation and Storage, Administrative and Support Services, Arts, Entertainment and Recreation, Construction, Accommodation and Food Services, and Real Estate Services.

sections.label: National Jobs Council placements
sections.summary: The National Jobs Council placed more than 174,000 jobseekers into jobs and skills opportunities as of end-December 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: To directly support local jobseekers, the National Jobs Council has placed more than 174,000 jobseekers into jobs and skills opportunities as of end-December 2021.

sections.label: Support for hiring long-term unemployed
sections.summary: Employers hiring long-term unemployed candidates receive up to 90% of salary costs, and Adecco was appointed first SGUnited Jobs and Skills Placement Partner.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Employers who hire long-term unemployed candidates will receive higher support of up to 90% of salary costs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: We have also appointed Adecco as our first SGUnited Jobs and Skills Placement Partner to provide additional job matching avenues for more vulnerable jobseekers, including the long-term unemployed.

sections.label: Job Transformation Maps planned
sections.summary: About 15 Job Transformation Maps are planned, developed with them.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We actually work with them to develop JTMs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: I think there are about 15  Job Transformation Maps (JTMs) planned.

sections.label: Older and less-educated jobseekers
sections.summary: Older people in their 50s and 60s and those with Secondary education have higher difficulty obtaining jobs, while the long-term unemployment rate is about 0.9%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Generally, the older age group, particularly from those that are in their 50s and 60s, have a relatively higher difficulty in obtaining jobs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: In terms of the educational level, typically, these are those who have not gotten Diplomas, I mean they have Secondary education.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: I want to add that the long-term unemployment rate is not high to begin with – we are at about 0.9%.
